ModMetaData.name: Landmark Editor
ModMetaData.author: Faeris
ModMetaData.description:
Adds two entries to the gizmos of a selected world tile in the Odyssey world view: "Set landmark" picks any landmark type for the tile and replaces the current one, and "Remove landmark" clears the landmark and the terrain mutators (lake, valley and similar) that the landmark added.
Mutator changes only affect maps generated afterwards. Maps that are already generated keep their terrain.
Removing a landmark also removes any mutator with the same name that the tile received from world generation.
Requires Odyssey and Harmony.
